_comment: GPU PCI-id -> compatible driver branch(es). Used by install.sh to auto-pick / validate the driver version for the detected GPU, so users never land on an incompatible branch (issue #77 class). 'branches' lists supported major branches, newest-preferred first. Extend as GPUs/branches are validated.

branch_notes.535: Production Branch. Maxwell..Ada. Recommended default for Pascal/Turing (verified: P620).
branch_notes.550: Newer GPUs; Pascal/Maxwell support present but being phased out in later branches - verify per GPU.
